answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day settles a sale of canyon scan analysis locating a pearl-inlaid relic and burns 3 tokens. Validators grade hidden checks and verify buyer signatures and an unused ID-bound burn receipt; failure denies listing. Self-buying qualifies; sampled checks do not prove full quality or distinct owners. Shared models and parallel sales can cut work, not reuse burns. Servers are reusable capital; burns are daily expense; no stake is locked. Four IDs destroy at least 4 x 3 = 12 tokens/day even if sale payments circle back.
